test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ramesh Sharma borrows Rs. 8,000 for 3 years at 5% p.a. simple interest. He lends it to Manohar at 7% p.a. for 3 years. Find his gain.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal of Rs.8000 borrowed for 3 years at 5% p.a. and the same sum was lent at 7% p.a. for the same time. 

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T)/100 

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest paid by Ramesh = 8000 × (5/100) × 3 = Rs.1200 

Simple Interest earned by Ramesh = 8000 × (7/100) × 3 = Rs.1680

**∴ Gain earned by Ramesh = Interest earned - Interest paid **

**⇒ 1680 - 1200 = Rs.480**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Total interest percent = R% × T

Total interest percent to be paid = 5% × 3 = 15%

Total interest percent to be earned = 7% × 3 = 21% 

Ramesh's gain = 21% - 15% = 6% 

**∴ Gain in Rs. = 8000 × 6/100 = Rs.480**
